name: Mazariegos (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of blue, green and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Mazariegos (a key and a cross on green and a saint on white).
history: Municipal flag of Mazariegos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Mazariegos arms — key and cross on green, saint on white
